description: Fill or change the sheet of an initiative (south element): what a committee reads in two minutes, no task management. Each field given replaces the stored one, null clears it, fields not given are kept. When an execution tool holds the project (external_ref set), keep the sheet as a summary of it and leave the tasks there. A new health (green, amber, red) needs health_note, one sentence that justifies it; update it at each review.

blockers.description: Risks, and what needs an arbitration or a decision of the committee

health.description: Weather of the initiative; needs health_note

health_note.description: One sentence that justifies the health

measured_by.description: UUID of the KPI (west element, same matrix) that measures the result

milestones.description: 3 to 6 dated milestones (8 at most); replaces the whole list

next_action.description: One action, who does it, by when

sponsor.description: Sponsor, when not the owner (the owner is owner_id of upsert_element)

why.description: The problem it addresses and the annual objective it serves

name: upsert_initiative_sheet
title: Edit an initiative sheet
